verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code "fetch and manage" account data. It also documents a REST API for manipulating account data and creating incidents, plus an Events API, and its docs state incidents can be triggered, acknowledged, and resolved via service integrations. Escalation runs automatically through escalation policies, but the evidence never shows an agent explicitly invoking escalate, acknowledge or resolve as named MCP tools or REST endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of specific MCP or REST operations for acknowledge, escalate/reassign and resolve, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full incident lifecycle without the dashboard.
